response.floor_summary: Floor 1 contains a single 2 BHK apartment unit comprising a master bedroom with en-suite bathroom, a second bedroom with access to a common bathroom, open-plan living and dining spaces, a Vastu-compliant kitchen with utility area, a pooja room, a north-facing balcony, an entry foyer, internal corridor, and a store — all sized at or above NBC India 2016 minimums within the 12 m × 18 m plot footprint.
